messages:
olivia (newhire): hi team, quick weird one on my first day. i clicked the GitHub invite email but the redwood-inference org doesn't appear on my profile. the invite page shows "You do not have access to this organization" and a link to connect SSO. i only have a hardware security key registered (no TOTP), and the SSO redirect errors with "No provisioning match for identity". help? :wave:
it-support: welcome olivia! can you DM your github username and the invite email? we use SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning; that "no provisioning match" usually means the email on your GH account doesn't match the invite. sometimes enterprise accounts (GH Enterprise Cloud) use a different domain for SSO and can cause extra friction.
olivia (newhire): sure — username is oliviam and invite went to olivia+work@fastmail.com. i did try incognito and signed out of my personal account before accepting.
devex: hi olivia, two quick suggestions: 1) if possible add olivia+work@fastmail.com to your github account and verify it before re-accepting, or 2) we can change the invite to match your primary GH email (admin side). also `gh auth login` then open the accept link usually helps.
it-support: thanks — resending invite now and forcing the SSO handshake to the identity provider at redwood-idp.example.com. scim-bot: Admin action: reissued org invite for olivia (olivia+work@fastmail.com) at 2024-04-10T09:18Z and queued SCIM mapping job.
onboard-bot: Onboarding checklist: 1) Accept org invite 2) Connect SSO 3) Enable 2FA (webAuthn or TOTP) + save recovery codes 4) Add SSH key -> https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/git
olivia (newhire): tried the new invite, SSO redirect failed again but the admin message said SCIM mapping queued. i temporarily enabled TOTP with Authy as a fallback and now SSO completed. i saved recovery codes and re-registered my YubiKey after.
it-support: good — SCIM completed and account linked. i've added you to the org membership manually while the sync finished. once you can see the org we'll add team membership.
ben (manager): @oliviam welcome! i'll approve access to the repos you need for ramping: read on `runtime`, `console`, and `ci-infra`. push is off by default; if you need it mention why.
onboard-bot: Automated: added olivia to team "eng-platform" (pending), will grant repo-level perms after manager approval.
it-support: next step: add your SSH key to GitHub (Settings -> SSH and GPG keys) or run `cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub | gh ssh-key add -t "olivia-work-laptop" -`. if you hit "Permission denied (publickey)" run `ssh -T git@github.com` then `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` and retry.
olivia (newhire): added SSH key, `ssh -T` greets me: "Hi oliviam! You've successfully authenticated". i still got a 404 cloning `git@github.com:redwood-inference/ci-infra.git` until ben confirmed repo grant.
ben (manager): granted olivia read access to runtime, console, and ci-infra. scim-bot: role assignment complete.
olivia (newhire): can clone and opened a tiny docs PR to fix a broken link. thanks everyone for the quick help :tada:
it-support: closing thread — if anything else pops up ping #help or DM us. :white_check_mark:
